tasks.task: Verify the website's navigation bar functionality between Home, Services, Workshops, Online Classes, Podcasts, Blogs, and Contact.
tasks.expected: The navigation bar should allow users to access all main sections of the website, including Home, Services, Workshops, Online Classes, Podcasts, Blogs, and Contact.

tasks.task: Test the e-commerce functionality by attempting to purchase a service.
tasks.expected: Users should be able to select a service, add it to the cart, proceed to checkout, enter payment details, and receive a confirmation message after a successful transaction.

tasks.task: Check the readability and relevance of content on the Blogs page.
tasks.expected: Blog entries should be relevant to leadership and business training, be free of grammatical errors, and have up-to-date content that aligns with the consulting theme.

tasks.task: Ensure the workshops' schedule information is clearly displayed.
tasks.expected: Users should be able to view detailed information about upcoming workshops, including dates, topics, and speakers, with the ability to register directly from the page.

tasks.task: Verify that the website uses 'light cyan' as the background color and 'cadet blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
tasks.expected: The website has a background color of 'light cyan' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'cadet blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

tasks.task: On the program finder, check the Leadership and Communication category filters and set the format filter to Live.
tasks.expected: Exactly four programs are listed — Foundations of Leadership, Difficult Conversations, Executive Presence, and Managing Remote Teams — and the live match count reads 4.

tasks.task: On the program finder, clear any other filters and type 200 into the max price box.
tasks.expected: Only Difficult Conversations, Conflict Resolution Essentials, and Team Communication Basics remain visible; Managing Remote Teams at $210 is filtered out.

tasks.task: On the program finder, type 100 into the max price box.
tasks.expected: No program cards are shown and a friendly no-matches note appears instead of a blank area or an error.

tasks.task: From the program finder, use the add-to-cart action on Executive Presence, then open the cart.
tasks.expected: Executive Presence appears in the existing cart priced at $320 and can proceed toward checkout like any other purchase.

tasks.task: From the Services page, add a service to the cart, proceed to checkout, and complete the purchase.
tasks.expected: The service lands in the cart, checkout accepts the details, and a confirmation message appears after completing the purchase.

tasks.task: On the team training estimator, pick Difficult Conversations and type 12 into the team size box.
tasks.expected: As typed, the quote updates without any submit action: it shows a 10% discount applied and a final total of $1,944.00.

tasks.task: On the estimator, pick Team Communication Basics and type 25 into the team size box.
tasks.expected: The 15% tier kicks in exactly at 25 people: the quote shows a 15% discount and a final total of $3,187.50, not the 10% tier's $3,375.00.

tasks.task: On the estimator, with any program picked, type 0 into the team size box.
tasks.expected: No NaN, error, or $0.00 quote appears — the estimator shows a friendly message asking for a valid team size and nothing crashes.

tasks.task: Open the program finder and look at the Conflict Resolution Essentials card.
tasks.expected: The card shows a colored pill badge reading On-Demand, matching the app-wide format badge convention.

tasks.task: On the program finder, check the Leadership and Communication category filters and set the format filter to Live.
tasks.expected: Exactly four programs are listed — Foundations of Leadership, Difficult Conversations, Executive Presence, and Managing Remote Teams — and the live match count reads 4.

tasks.task: Open the saved learning paths page and look at New Manager Ramp-Up.
tasks.expected: It contains Foundations of Leadership, Difficult Conversations, and Coaching for Performance, with a combined price of $680 and a total of 16 hrs.

tasks.task: From the program finder, add only Executive Presence to a new path draft, type the name Solo Track in the path name field, and try to save.
tasks.expected: Saving is refused with a message that a path needs at least two programs, and nothing new appears on the saved paths page.

tasks.task: From the program finder, use the add-to-path action on Foundations of Leadership twice, then open the draft review.
tasks.expected: Foundations of Leadership appears only once in the draft, and the totals count it a single time ($240 and 6 hrs).

tasks.task: On the program finder, check only the Coaching category filter, use the add-to-path action on the single result, and open the draft review.
tasks.expected: The filtered result is Coaching for Performance, and the draft review lists it with $260 and 6 hrs.

tasks.task: On the team training estimator, pick Difficult Conversations and type 12 into the team size box.
tasks.expected: As typed, the quote updates without any submit action: it shows a 10% discount applied and a final total of $1,944.00.

tasks.task: Open the New Manager Ramp-Up path and look at its progress readout.
tasks.expected: With Foundations of Leadership already marked done, it reads 6 of 16 hrs completed and the percent shows 38% (not 37%).

tasks.task: In the New Manager Ramp-Up path, mark Difficult Conversations as done.
tasks.expected: Completed hours move to 10 of 16 hrs and the percent updates to 63% (62.5 rounded up).

tasks.task: In the New Manager Ramp-Up path, mark Difficult Conversations and Coaching for Performance as done.
tasks.expected: Progress reads 16 of 16 hrs and 100%, and a Certificate of Completion appears on screen showing the path name New Manager Ramp-Up and 16 hrs.

tasks.task: From the program finder, add Conflict Resolution Essentials and Team Communication Basics to a path draft, name it Quick Start, and save it.
tasks.expected: Quick Start saves and shows fresh progress of 0 of 8 hrs and 0%, with done toggles for both programs and no certificate shown.

tasks.task: On the program finder, clear any other filters and type 200 into the max price box.
tasks.expected: Only Difficult Conversations, Conflict Resolution Essentials, and Team Communication Basics remain visible; Managing Remote Teams at $210 is filtered out.

tasks.task: Open the program finder and look at its page heading and its primary action buttons.
tasks.expected: The heading is left-aligned with a short teal underline accent beneath it, and primary buttons are deep teal (#0F766E) with white text.

tasks.task: On the program finder, look at the Executive Presence card.
tasks.expected: Its price reads $320 in bold dark slate (#334155) and the card has visibly rounded 12px corners.

tasks.task: Open the original Services page and then the estimator page.
tasks.expected: Both pages keep the light cyan background, their headings are left-aligned with the teal underline, and their primary buttons are deep teal with white text — the restyle isn't limited to the new pages.

tasks.task: Open the saved learning paths page and look at the New Manager Ramp-Up card.
tasks.expected: The card has 12px rounded corners and its $680 total renders bold in dark slate, consistent with the rest of the site.

tasks.task: Open the saved learning paths page and look at New Manager Ramp-Up.
tasks.expected: It contains Foundations of Leadership, Difficult Conversations, and Coaching for Performance, with a combined price of $680 and a total of 16 hrs.

tasks.task: Register for Ask Me Anything: Difficult Conversations with a name and a valid email, completing the review step.
tasks.expected: A seat is confirmed and the session immediately shows 15 of 15 seats taken and reads as full.

tasks.task: Open the live sessions page and register for Executive Roundtable, entering a name and a valid email.
tasks.expected: Because all 10 seats are taken, no seat is granted; the flow offers a waitlist spot instead and the confirmation shows waitlist position 1.

tasks.task: Start registering for Remote Team Rituals, type Jordan in the name field and not-an-email in the email field, and try to continue.
tasks.expected: The form refuses to proceed, pointing at the invalid email; no confirmation appears and no registration is created.

tasks.task: Register for Remote Team Rituals with a name and a valid email, then open the My Registrations page.
tasks.expected: The new Remote Team Rituals registration sits above the pre-existing Leading Through Change one — newest first.

tasks.task: Open the New Manager Ramp-Up path and look at its progress readout.
tasks.expected: With Foundations of Leadership already marked done, it reads 6 of 16 hrs completed and the percent shows 38% (not 37%).

tasks.task: Open the My Learning dashboard right after loading the app.
tasks.expected: It reads 18 hrs committed (16 from the New Manager Ramp-Up path plus 2 from the Leading Through Change registration), 6 hrs completed, an overall 33%, 1 saved path, and 0 certificates.

tasks.task: Mark Coaching for Performance done in New Manager Ramp-Up, then open the dashboard.
tasks.expected: Completed hours rise from 6 to 12 hrs and the overall percent recomputes to 67% (12 of 18).

tasks.task: Mark Difficult Conversations and Coaching for Performance done in New Manager Ramp-Up, then open the dashboard.
tasks.expected: The certificates count shows 1, completed hours read 16 hrs, and the overall percent reads 89% (16 of 18).

tasks.task: Register for Remote Team Rituals with a name and a valid email, then open the My Learning dashboard.
tasks.expected: Committed hours rise from 18 to 20 hrs and the overall percent drops to 30% (6 of 20).

tasks.task: Open the live sessions page and register for Executive Roundtable, entering a name and a valid email.
tasks.expected: Because all 10 seats are taken, no seat is granted; the flow offers a waitlist spot instead and the confirmation shows waitlist position 1.

tasks.task: On the training matcher, choose Individual as the role and Communication as the topic.
tasks.expected: The top three read, in order: Team Communication Basics, then Conflict Resolution Essentials, then Difficult Conversations — the 4.6-rating tie broken alphabetically.

tasks.task: On the training matcher, choose Manager as the role and Leadership as the topic.
tasks.expected: The top three read, in order: Foundations of Leadership, then Managing Remote Teams (both two-point matches, higher rating first), then Executive Presence as the best one-point match.

tasks.task: With Manager and Leadership selected, switch the topic to Coaching.
tasks.expected: The list reshuffles immediately with no submit action, and Coaching for Performance moves to the top spot.

tasks.task: With Manager and Leadership selected, use the add-to-path shortcut to put Managing Remote Teams into New Manager Ramp-Up, then open that path.
tasks.expected: New Manager Ramp-Up now lists four programs with updated totals of $890 and 21 hrs.

tasks.task: On the program finder, look at the Executive Presence card.
tasks.expected: Its price reads $320 in bold dark slate (#334155) and the card has visibly rounded 12px corners.

tasks.task: Switch the header currency picker to GBP and open the program finder.
tasks.expected: Foundations of Leadership shows £189.60 — converted at the fixed 0.79 rate and formatted to two decimals.

tasks.task: Switch the currency to EUR and open the saved learning paths page.
tasks.expected: New Manager Ramp-Up's total reads €625.60 (680 times 0.92), converted like every other price on the site.
